newsitem.title: USA: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer movie studio planning IPO.
newsitem.headline: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer movie studio planning IPO.

text.p: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, the movie studio that brought us the popular movies "Goldeneye", "Get Shorty" and "The Birdcage" said Tuesday it is planning to go public.

MGM, which said it will soon file with the government for an offering, produces and distributes entertainment products -- movies, television programming, home video, interactive media, music, and licensed merchandise. The company runs MGM Pictures, United Artists Pictures, Orion Pictures, Goldwyn Entertainment, MGM Worldwide Television Group, MGM Distribution Co, MGM Home Entertainment and Consumer Products Group, MGM Music and MGM Interactive, among others.
